主要内容: On January 25, 2013, the Small Business Administration (SBA) committed to reserve leverage in the form of debentures in an amount equal to $5.0 million to Medallion Capital, Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary of Medallion Financial Corp.. Medallion Capital accepted the commitment on January 28, 2013 and paid a leverage fee of $50,000. The remaining leverage fee of $100,000 will be deducted pro rata as Medallion Capital draws from the commitment proceeds. Medallion Capital can draw from the commitment proceeds until September 30, 2017, the commitment's expiration date. The commitment is attached as an exhibit to the Form 8-K filing and is incorporated by reference in its entirety. This financing agreement is significant for Medallion Financial Corp. and the financial services industry, as it provides leverage through debentures and outlines the terms of the commitment and associated fees.
